horoscope: Sagittarius should try to let go of old emotions and anything that is holding you back. In love, recognise your worth and maintain clarity in your relationships. In finances, you will notice your interest being more focused towards money because of the Moon's transit into Cancer. This is also a good time to complete pending work. Our astrologers advise you to embrace changes with a positive attitude.
love: For Sagittarius, Venus' influence will draw you toward someone from your past today. However, be aware that past relationships that have hurt you are not the right choice for your future. That is why you should reflect on your past and learn what it has taught you. Our astrologers advise you not to compromise on your self-respect anymore and prioritise your happiness.
finance: For Sagittarius, Venus' influence will support your efforts to strengthen your financial position. You will notice opportunities arise that can increase your income. Also, there are chances that old investments could also bring potential gains. Astrotalk astrologers advise you to focus on long-term financial gains, rather than short-term profits.
career: For Sagittarius, Mercury will encourage you to focus on completing old projects and long-standing pending tasks. This is a good period to wrap up that work and prepare for a new project. Our astrologers advise you not to delay important decisions and to complete your work in an organised manner.
health: For Sagittarius, eating outside food frequently or following an irregular routine may affect your health today. However, because of the Jupiter's influence you will make better food choices. Our astrologers advise you to eat fresh, home-cooked meals that are balanced in nutrition. If any health concerns arise, do not ignore them.
